description: Saved-object type against operation. Writes come first and reads after; cell volume is colour on a log scale, teal (fewest) through blue and purple to pink (most), so a single delete stays visible beside thousands of reads in either theme; the legend labels the fewest and the most events drawn and the decades between. An operation outside the suite's verbs keeps Kibana's own words (remove refs: saved_object_remove_references, a tag unlinked from objects), or reads "no action" where Kibana recorded none (a Fleet policy deploy), and sits between the changes and the reads. Past 13 object types the rest fold into one "N more types" row so every row stays readable at any volume; types with a write rank first, so a rare change is not the one folded.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | EVAL obj_id = COALESCE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.id, g_id) | WHERE obj_id IS NOT NULL | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY attributes.event.action, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, obj_id | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | EVAL verb = CASE(verb == "other", COALESCE(attributes.event.action, "no action"), verb) | EVAL obj_type = CASE(attributes.kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", attributes.event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", attributes.event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", attributes.event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", attributes.event.action == "secret_create", "secret", attributes.event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | STATS events = SUM(n), objects = COUNT_DISTINCT(obj_id) BY so_type = obj_type, verb
